title: "[feature] "

## Problem / motivation

What problem does this solve? Who is it for (contributor, operator, vetter,
recipient institution)?

## Proposed change

What you'd like to see. If it touches detection, verification, capture, vetting,
or routing, note which layer.

## Safety frames

Cairn weighs every capability against five frames. If your proposal touches the
detection/action path, note how it relates to: (1) does it work, (2) could it
harm good people, (3) is it legal, (4) is it auditable, (5) is a human in the
loop where required.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches and why this one.

## Additional context

Links, prior art, references.
